title: Add measured dispatch, GPU phase and synchronization budgets
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Make the real-time schedule's emitted work and synchronization cost observable and regression-tested on all adapters without required instrumentation stalls. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Report actual dispatches/workgroups, index build/refit/publication counts, numerical iterations, barriers, submissions, readbacks and bytes moved by major phase in per-tick units.
Capture CPU encode/submit/wait and GPU index/candidate/domain/coupling/commit time using asynchronous bounded query storage; explicitly label unsupported timing and instrumentation overhead.
Machine-readable reports include source/artifact/deployment identity, workload counts, profile/budget versions, warmup, p50/p95/p99, thermals and simulation-to-wall-clock ratio.
Negative tests catch extra iterations/rebuilds and budget regressions; disabling telemetry removes mandatory query/readback overhead.
